title.narrative: Preparation Cooperation National Civil Protection Agencies Albania
Preparation Cooperation National Civil Protection Agencies Albania

description.narrative: Bidraget ska tjäna till att utveckla ett långsiktigt bilateralt samarbete mellan de albanska och de svenska civilskyddsmyndigheterna för att öka motståndskraften mot katastrofer.
The contribution will serve to develop a long-erm bilateral cooperation between the Albanian and the Swedish Civil Protection agencies, in order to increase resilience against disasters.

This intervention intends to assess the feasibility of a full-term bilateral cooperation between the MSB Swedish Contingencies Agency (MSB) and Albanian Civil Protection Agency (NCPA) in the area of Disaster Risk Reduction (DRR), with the aim of supporting NCPA to strengthen its role as the coordinator of the DDR system in the country, and achieve its membership in the EU Civil Protection Mechanism (UCPM) to its highest benefit.
The intervention will carry out the following:
1. explore the needs, interest and incentives of the NCPA for capacity- and partnership development with MSB;
2. map and review existing stakeholders, ongoing projects and other initiatives supporting the agency and the disaster risk management system and
3. assess and suggest how MSB, through its comparative advantages as a national civil protection agency and within the framework of Swedish development aid, EU- and international DRR priorities, and the process for Albania to become a participating state to the UCPM, could meet identified capacity needs and gaps.
If it is assessed that a cooperation initiative between NCPA and MSB is feasible, a project proposal for a long-term bilateral cooperation between the two agencies will be developed, and handed in to Sida for funding. That will be the overall result of the intervention.

The expected results of the preassessment included the following: 1. To explore the needs, interest and incentive of the NCPA for capacity and partnership development with MSB 2. To map and review existing stakeholders, ongoing projects and other initiatives supporting the agency and the disaster risk management system and 3. To assess and suggest how MSB, through its comparative advantages as a national civil protection agency and within the framework of Swedish development aid, EU and international DRR priorities, and the process for Albania to become a participating state to the UCPM, could meet identified capacity needs and gaps. 4. If it is assessed that a cooperation initiative between NCPA and MSB is feasible, a project proposal will be developed and handed in to Sida. MSB, in close dialogue with NCPA, has conducted a range of activities, including field visits, bilateral and multilateral meetings, online and onsite workshops, desk-study and others. Among main activities the following can be highlighted: -desk study implemented by Lund University (February 2023) -capacity and needs assessment (May 2023) online validation workshop (October 2023) stakeholder consultations workshop in Tirana (December 2024) elaboration of the project proposal and its anchoring with the NCPA (December 2024)
Among the project results are: MSB and NCPA agreeing on the overall goal of potential cooperation being enhanced public awareness of disaster risks and ways for household emergency preparedness in Albania, with strengthened capacity of NCPA to coordinate disaster preparedness efforts in Albania as a specific goal of the future project. These outcomes would be achieved through: Improved coherence and consistency of disaster preparedness efforts in Albania and its alignment with EU's practices Enhanced interinstitutional cooperation between academia/education sector and other civil protection actors in the area of public awareness and community preparedness Increased capacity of the central civil protection institutions, municipalities to communicate and train their respective target audiences in civil protection and disaster preparedness 1.5 Assessment of achieved results in relation to the objectives The process of the pre-assessment implementation was not linear, encountered several changes of direction and even a temporary slowdown between October 2023 and May 2024 due to high workload of NCPA in conjunction with launch of IPA CARE and the need of MSB to invest in coordinating and building complementarity between the bilateral cooperation and the cooperation implemented with EU funds (IPA CARE), by leading a consortium of other civil protection agencies. However, the agility in adjusting to changes in development needs for the Albanian partner and the attention provided in building organizational consensus on the content and expectations of the future bilateral cooperation between the MSB and NACP, has made possible that the proposal developed reflects the ownership and commitment from the Albanian partner. Thus, the confirmed feasibility and relevance of bilateral collaboration, as well as the clarity built about priority areas to be addressed, has resulted in the project proposal developed in close collaboration between MSB and NCPA. Conducted analysis of Albanian context and the NCPAs capacity and needs, confirms necessity and feasibility of establishing bilateral cooperation between Albanian and Swedish civil protection agencies, particularly in public awareness and crisis communication. The project proposal submitted to Sida is well-developed. Sida's assessment based also on direct attendance of the validation workshop and continuous contacts and dialogue with both cooperation partners, is that the proposal developed and submitted to Sida represents a joint work and can pave the way to an effective cooperation. Sida's overall conclusion is that the current intervention has achieved its planned results and the extension in time, has been justified through the end.results.
